Episode 1
videos.overview: 24 Australians arrive on the tropical island of Samoa ready to outwit, outplay and outlast each other in order to win the half a million dollar prize and the title of sole survivor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The tribes compete in an Immunity Challenge to avoid tribal council where they will be forced to vote a team mate off the island. Who will be the second contestant to leave the island?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A physical Reward Challenge will push the tribes to their limits for a tarp & cushions. Later, the Immunity Challenge sees the tribes compete on a puzzle to avoid heading to Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: One tribe is struggling to make fire and morale is at an all-time low. They must win today's Immunity Challenge to lift their spirits & avoid Tribal Council to vote another contestant off the island.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Facing elimination, the three tribes head to the Immunity Challenge. Which team will return to camp triumphant and which teams will be left to ponder what happened at Tribal Council?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The tribes are still reeling after last night's tribal council but will need to put their differences aside and unite to compete in an epic Immunity Challenge.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The reward challenge will set tummies rumbling as the contestants compete for a BBQ feast. In the Immunity Challenge each tribe will be challenged to carry their own weight to avoid Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Last night's losing tribe is on edge after another tense elimination. One contestant is feeling increasingly insecure about their spot in the tribe. Will they be eliminated next?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As the dust settles from last night's shock tribal council result, some tribe mates are feeling anxious about their position in the game and scramble to make new alliances.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: One tribe mate is left feeling guilty and in shock after last night's tribal council. The result has caused a rift in the tribe and a very obvious division between some tribe mates.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: After receiving a vote at tribal council, one tribe member is shocked after surviving the vote. They are hurt and angry, but do they have the numbers to seek revenge?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tribal tensional continues to escalate when two people come to blows over their sleeping arrangements. With the losing team heading to tribal council who will be the next person to leave the island?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Which tribe can muster the strength to win the reward challenge for a huge traditional Samoan feast? Plus, Jonathan reveals a massive twist that will give a tribe a huge advantage in the game.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: One tribemate wakes the morning after Tribal Council furious that their strategy has been exposed while other tribemates bask in their new found power heading into the Reward & Immunity Challenge.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: One tribe is still shocked after the last tribal council, but they try and rally each other back together anticipating another Immunity Challenge to avoid another elimination.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: After the final tribe merger the castaways jostle for position to control the game. With power held by a select few one contestant sets upon a plan to change the game but is it too little too late?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: One tribe mate is furious after last night's tribal council and is determined to get revenge. At the reward challenge Jonathan announces that the winning team will each receive a letter from home.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Last night's tribal council left alliances exposed and the tribe in turmoil. Paranoia sets in for some tribe mates. Will they have to turn on each other just to keep themselves in the game?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Today's reward challenge is for a delicious Sunday Roast which will be perfect fuel for the immunity challenge. Who will be safe from tonight's tribal council vote?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tribal politics continue to escalate but one tribemate thinks their back is against the wall and no amount of scrambling can save them. Will they get a lifeline?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Some tribemates are furious about the accusations made at the last tribal council. Now with the jury there to watch the discussions play out, will it impact their chance of winning?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: With alliances hanging in the balance, the contestants head to the reward challenge in an effort to win a luxury spa night. Later, who will be voted out and become the next jury member?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Emotions are running high now that the castaways are getting closer to the finale. The tribemates are starting to second guess their strategies. Is now the time to change it up?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: With only five contestants remaining, strategy reaches fever pitch as each tribemate ponders who should be the next to go.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Only four contestants remain and the next move they make will determine the finalists. The penultimate Immunity Challenge is one that each tribemate feels confident they can win.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: With only three castaways left remaining, who will win the half a million dollar prize and the title of sole survivor?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 24 Australians arrive on the tropical island of Samoa ready to outwit, outplay and outlast each other in order to win the half a million dollar prize and the title of sole survivor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The perfect storm is brewing in Samoa as the tribes fight to protect supplies & maintain fire in adverse conditions. However, how will the prospect of a possible idol at play tamper with the newly formed friendships?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As a major alliance crumbles, one tribe scrambles to avoid elimination. The other tribe grows frustrated with two members and make moves to have them removed next.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Food is the only thing on the minds of the castaways as one member from each camp faces a painful moral dilemma which could have dramatic ramifications for the tribemates & their own game.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tensions run high as the castaways endure further wind & rain without fire and shelter before a lengthy immunity challenge finishing with the next Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Blatant lies at the last tribal council has put everyone in one camp on edge. Will they be able to put their differences aside to win the reward challenge or will they leave hungry?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A brutal tribal council the night before has left one castaway on the war path seeking retribution. At the immunity challenge, the tribes must take part in a physical Sumo'an contest

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As both tribes appear to reach their wits end, the prospect of a luxurious and cleansing reward could be enough to keep the castaways in the game for weeks to come.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Winning immunity has never been so vital to resettling the balance within each tribe, and with a highly competitive challenge that encourages fair contact, things are sure to get feisty.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Social divisions begin to exhaust castaways as one tribe breaks down ahead of the next immunity challenge. Will they be able to come together to avoid another visit to tribal council?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Aligned castaways find themselves at each other's throats over who is doing enough work around camp, but is one player acting lazy to divide the tribe?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A surprise challenge sees one castaway return to camp with an unexpected power that could push tensions to breaking point. Later, will one castaway past come back to haunt them at tribal council?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Alliances continue to flip as a former power player finds themselves at the bottom of their tribe, and a last minute scramble to return to their former glory will turn friend against friend.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Betrayal runs rampant within both tribes as deceptive immunity clues and relentless strategising begins to place targets on the backs of castaways who had previously flown under the radar.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The fallout from one of the most dramatic Tribal Councils this season sends shockwaves through one tribe as castaways scramble to repair broken bonds.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Change is in the air as time comes for the biggest event in the game so far: a merger. Emotions continue to run high when a particularly difficult reward challenge offers a deeply sentimental prize.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The fallout from the first group tribal council tears a rift between the newly formed tribe, resulting in a huge clash of alliances. Who will be the next contestant to have their flame extinguished?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: A shock display of power at the last tribal council places an immediate target on one castaway. Will the new shift in camp dynamics be enough to remove a prolific player from the game?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: A scheming conversation is overheard, putting one contestant in the firing line, and an alliance is shattered, resulting in one of the most divided tribal councils this series.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Another alliance is in jeopardy as one contestant decides to flip on a fellow tribesman, planning the biggest blindside this season, but an unexpected turn of events forces the castaway to reconsider.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The battle for individual immunity is at an all-time high and contestants must compete in a fast-paced memory challenge to secure their safety for another day going into tribal council.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: With alliances crumbling and paranoia setting in, all six castaways are determined to win individual immunity. In an explosive Tribal Council, one contestant holds the power, but who will they choose?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: After seven weeks on the island of Samoa, only five contestants remain in the race towards winning $500,000 in prize money. Who will become the next member of the Jury?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After 50 testing days on the island of Samoa, the final four contestants go into the challenge, not for immunity but for an advantage: to eliminate a member of the jury at Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The final four start to plan and collude on who they will vote off next at Tribal Council, but this is Survivor, and anybody could win immunity.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: With only three castaways remaining, who will win the $500,000 prize and the title of sole survivor?

videos.title: Survivor Reunion
videos.overview: Aligned castaways find themselves at each other's throats over who is doing enough work around camp, but is one player acting lazy to divide the tribe?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In a world-first, this program has pitted 12 giants of Australian society against 12 everyday Aussies in order to create one epic battle: champions versus contenders.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The game starts to become very real for the castaways. The reality of having to catch their own food and create a liveable shelter becomes top priority in camp.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In the Champions camp a new leader steps forward and starts calling the shots, while over at The Contenders it's a case of the boys versus the girls.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Reeling after a shocking outcome in Tribal, one tribe is very unsettled and new targets start to come under fire.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A castaway who has been struggling with the game becomes determined to stick with the fight. While one of the Contenders struggles with an injury so serious, it could spell the end of their game.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: From illness to dummy spits, time in isolation is starting to take its toll on some of the Castaways and it's causing unease in the camps.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After a surprising tribal council result, some castaways realise they're on the outer and start to scramble to make alliances within their tribe.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The twist in the previous game has one tribe torn and plotting new strategies to kick out one of the biggest competitors in the game.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The game steps it up a notch when two castaways who have been on the edge of their team come face-to-face in front of their tribe.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After losing at an endurance challenge for immunity, one team enters in what looks to be the fiercest Tribal Council yet.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: After 25 days on the island, the castaways have made the halfway point in the game, and their chance of becoming Sole Survivor is getting closer and more obtainable.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After a massive shake-up in the game, both tribes are cautiously reforming plans and forging new alliances.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As the game heats up with a merger, some islanders are starting to struggle, while others are just beginning to orchestrate their big moves. One of the program's biggest threats will be cut loose.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: It's auction time. The hungry castaways are given $500 each to enter into a new kind of battle where food is the hottest property in town.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Mat and Robbie have faced off time and time again, but is it time to send one of them home?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The end game is getting closer. Hold your breath! Contenders will rise and champions will fall. The big players make their move.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The end game is getting closer and the scramble for survival more desperate, sparking the hunt for idols. Later, at a massive Tribal Council, one player's confidence just might cost them the game.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After an unexpected result at Tribal Council, the Castaways' Camp is a hive of animosity and distrust. Hard truths come to the surface and split the opinions of the tribe.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: With only seven castaways that still remain, the game's power rests with one, and it's not who you think. What Monica is about to do next really shakes things up.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: With bitter grudges in play, victory at an immunity challenge has never been more important. At Tribal Council, accusations fly as some tribe members are accused of being carried through the game.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: As the game comes close to the end, the taste of victory is closer than ever. Trust between the castaways is at an all-time low and a bold move is made by a player to gain further power.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As the pointy end of the game closes in on the remaining five castaways, one player seeks revenge after the previous tribal council.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: With only a few days left in the game, physical strength dwindling and emotions at an all-time high, the castaways are granted an opportunity for immunity, thus securing their place in the final three.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After 50 testing days, the remaining three castaways can finally see and feel the eagerly anticipated finish line ahead of them, with one of the greatest battles for immunity in front of them.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: We announce the winner of Australian Survivor for 2018, plus a reunion special hosted by Jonathan LaPaglia.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In the ultimate test of the human spirit, 12 everyday Aussies take on 12 Australian champions over 50 days to see who can outwit, outplay and outlast to become the sole 'survivor'.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Only a few days on the island, and alliances are already starting to form. It's still a team game as the rewards challenge requires a huge effort from all in order to take home some fishing equipment.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After a loss at the Immunity Challenge, one tribe will contemplate a major betrayal in order to rid the game of one of its most powerful players.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The contenders play hard in the challenges, desperate to prove they've got what it takes to win. Tensions are high at Tribal Council with one player taken down in an epic blindside and sent home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Strategic gameplay is underway as one of the contestants finds an idol and needs to decide fast who can be trusted. Paranoia sets in at Tribal Council with confusion and panic taking over.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Paranoia starts to set in across both tribes with rumours of contestants having idols, but are they real or fake? At Tribal Council, the tribe are faced with some big questions around leadership.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A massive twist in the game sees things shaken up for both the Contenders and the Champions. Old alliances will be broken, and those who were at the top of the game find themselves on the bottom.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Who is controlling the game? Will their antics soon be uncovered? Will they fall victim to their own success? Or are they still calling the shots?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In camp, plans start to unravel, leading to an epic Tribal Council no one saw coming that leaves everyone shocked.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Tribe members have been given a wake up call, and it's clear to everyone that it's every man for himself in the game of Survivor.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: One Tribe considers a huge move in order to keep an alliance strong. But will they go through with it? At Tribal Council, there is a dramatic exit.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With the first challenge involving heights and blindfolds and the second requiring all their strength, everyone is pushed to the edge - except one survivor who appears to be throwing the game.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Things get a bit panicked around the camps with all survivors feeling their necks on the line, but an unexpected setback at the challenge will turn the whole game on its head.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The first challenge consists of a series of temptations. What will the hungry survivors fall for? And one survivor makes sure that if they're going down, they're going down in flames.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: We are well and truly down to an individual game now and this time around, the prize is a brand-new car. What lengths will the survivors go to get their hands on the keys?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The survivors enter one of the biggest Tribal Councils of the season as an unexpected move turns the game on its head.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: An unlikely duo battle it out in an endurance challenge. All sorts of names are being thrown up for the Tribal Council vote, but the name that keeps coming up the most is one you won't expect.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The individual game gets desperate with several Survivors sneaking around camp searching for the idol that will save their game. Secrets aren't staying safe leading into a high-drama Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Storms roll over camp and dampen all moods. As we inch closer towards the pointy end of things, old alliances are starting to crack as everyone starts to fight hard for their place in the game.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: When two of the biggest warriors in the game go head-to-head, a hard-fought battle ends in tears. It's a brutal Tribal Council where some hard truths are laid on the line.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The survivors dive into some of the heaviest gameplay of the season. Loyalties fly out the window and old alliances are broken as each survivor tries desperately to keep their place in the tribe.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: No one is safe at this point in the game, leaving all contestants desperate to get their hands on the Immunity necklace to buy themselves another day in camp.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: With the end in sight, every move the contestants make could be the difference between making the final three or being voted out of the game.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: On the last day, the final two contestants head to their last Tribal Council where they have to convince the jury that they deserve the title of sole survivor.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The best competition on TV is bigger than ever. The biggest villains, game players and heroes, are seeking redemption and competing against each other in the first ever Australian Survivor: All Stars.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Proving it's game on, things heat up between tribe mates, with new alliances being formed and others being kept in the dark. An intense Tribal Council sees a much loved character say goodbye.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: They don't call it All Stars for nothing, and this episode proves just how cutthroat Survivor royalty can be with the most epic Tribal Council the show has seen.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When both tribes meet at the reward challenge, what they're fighting for isn't what it seems to the disappointment of the winning tribe.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: With a romance sparking between two tribe mates, will a power couple be formed and hold strong as the game progresses?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Needing to pull together to ensure success reward and immunity wins, both tribes put their differences aside and fight a hard fight to win.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After not one but two unexpected departures, one tribe member wakes up especially confident that they have a hold on the game.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Still playing the game in their tribes, the immunity challenge is thrown on its head with not one, but two single immunity necklaces up for grabs.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Everyone's favourite Survivor reward is up for grabs - it's the Survivor Auction. However, the rules have changed and instead of using individual cash, each tribe has a communal kitty to pool from.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After Tribe swap, things are a bit shaky for a few tribe members lost without their alliances. Tribe members scramble to show their loyalty, but will the vote be swayed in their favour?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With one Tribe on a winning streak, the opposing castaways need to put their alliances aside and really work together to ensure an immunity challenge win.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The sun rises on an All Stars milestone - our castaways have hit the halfway mark and are one day closer to merge! One castaway aims to enact long awaited revenge but does everything go to plan?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Things get a bit panicked around the camps with all Survivors feeling their necks on the line, but an unexpected setback at the challenge will turn the whole game on its head.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The Tribe Merge is here and the first challenge consists of a series of temptations. What will the hungry Survivors fall for?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: We are well and truly down to an individual game now and this time around, the prize is a brand new car. What lengths will the Survivors go to get their hands on the keys?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The Survivors enter one of the biggest Tribal Councils of the season as an unexpected move turns the game on its head.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: An unlikely duo battle it out in an endurance challenge. All sorts of names are being thrown up for the Tribal Council vote, but the name that keeps coming up the most is one you won't expect.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The individual game gets desperate with several Survivors sneaking around camp searching for the idol that will save their game. Secrets aren't staying safe leading into a high-drama Tribal Council!

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: As we inch closer towards the pointy end of things, old alliances are starting to crack as everyone starts to fight hard for their place in the game.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Sometimes the swing vote in Survivor is the most powerful position to be in. During Tribal Council, one tribe member is implored for their vote by both sides, giving them the power of the game.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: After missing out on the immunity challenge win, a hunt for an idol ensues and as always with Tribal Council, not all is as it seems and Jonathan has one last trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: With one tribe member on the bottom of the group, they know the only way to secure their place in the game is to win individual immunity.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: With the next immunity challenge deciding who will make the final three, it's more important than ever to be on your game, but for one castaway, island life is taking a toll on their body.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Three become two in an epic showdown of endurance and strength in the final challenge and then, arguments are pitched and the Jury votes are cast to determine who will be crowned the Sole Survivor.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Join us for the live reveal of the Sole Survivor. With the castaways all back together, it's the tell all reunion show no one will want to miss.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Cloncurry in north-west Queensland is where the ultimate battle between Brains and Brawn begins. As soon as the castaways hit the red dirt, it's every man for themselves to win the first reward challenge.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's a new day, settling into camp, Sleeping rough has taken it's toll. With Immunity Idols hidden around both the Brains and Brawn camps, the race is on for Castaways to get their hands on them first.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Cracks and alliances have started to appear in both the Brains and Brawn camps. The split amongst one Tribe is evident at Tribal Council but with a hidden Immunity Idol at play, will things go to plan?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After last Tribal Council, the minority group in the Brawn Tribe realize they're in a dangerous position and work to better their alliances. Then, at a tense Tribal Council, one Castaway is eliminated.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: One lucky Castaway who currently holds an immunity idol finds another. And later, battlelines are drawn at another intense Tribal Council, that lands on a surprising outcome.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Both Tribes begin to struggle with the harsh reality of the Aussie outback. Tensions are high and tears are shed at an emotional Tribal Council. But all is not what it seems.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Our hungry Castaways walk into the BBQ Feast Reward Challenge. Then, when one Tribe enters the ring for the Immunity Challenge, tensions flair with a Castaway forced to sit out and watch how it's done.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tongues start to wag in both camps with ousted Castaways revealing who is in possession of Hidden Immunity Idols, hoping to flush them out. Then, it's blindside time at Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When winning Reward also doubles as winning Immunity, all bets are off, especially when the winners will also score champagne and bar snacks. With both Tribes attending Tribal Council, fireworks ensue.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: One Tribe thinks they have it in the bag, but a surprise outcome means full bellies and a good night's sleep for the overall winners. With firm alliances rearing their head at a heated Tribal council.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Even when you think your private conversation won't be heard by others, it almost always is. The other Castaways use the overheard information to their advantage amongst their own Tribal alliance.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Desperation is setting in on one Tribe with members gunning for one person in particular. Now to flush their idol! And a good old fashioned blindside sees one Castaway scratching their head.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: It's the moment the remaining Castaways have been waiting for, Tribe merge! Not everyone knows who to trust and with a couple of Idols in play, tonight's Tribal Council is anyone's game.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: In an Immunity Challenge with a twist, there are three Immunity Idols up for grabs. Whoever scores one will see Tribal Council will swing in their favour...or will it?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The Immunity Challenge tests our hangry Castaways on spelling and balancing, with a challenge beast setting their eyes on the prize. Plus, At Tribal Council, a double agent is outed!

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Tensions within Brawn start a double blindside, but there's an importance in a blindside of picking the right target at the right time.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: It's Day 34 in the Australian Outback, and the feeling at camp is excitement for Brains, who now rule the camp. The biggest KEY to playing Survivor is to keep your closest allies safe.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: George and Cara have stuck by each other through thick and thin, however, when the rest of the Tribe realise, will the King and Queen of Survivor's reign be over?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: George survives tribal by the skin of his teeth to regain the majority, but his ability to stay in the game lies in the hands of one person, Wai.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Dani and Flick are on the bottom of the pack, but they are two strong physical and social threats who are here to fight. Will George's kingdom crumble under the persuasive powers of the remaining Brawn?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Dani concedes that the only way to get ahead in this game is to exploit some cracks in the majority alliance, but that would mean trusting someone who has betrayed her in the past.

videos.title: Episode 22
